summary:
Iter15 — CYBERPUNK TERMINAL v3.0 + 7 NEW ROUTERS + GROWTH-ROUTES-TO-NOTIFICATION fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing (/app/backend/tests/test_iter15.py, 12.17s). Coverage: notifications full CRUD (POST/GET/count/seen/seen-all/DELETE one/DELETE all — verified via curl: created→counted→seen-all marked 9→deleted one→deleted all 9→count back to 0/0); files upload (multipart 'file' field, returns FileItem with is_text=true + text_preview, list excludes base64, /download returns exact bytes, DELETE removes); files >2MB → 413; browser /api/browser/fetch on https://example.com returns {status:200, title:'Example Domain', text contains 'Example Domain', links[1]}; invalid host returns {status:0, error}; server /diagnose for 1.1.1.1 https returns REACHABLE with tcp_ok=true http=200 server=cloudflare ~489ms; ssh://github.com returns GATED (by design); satellite /feed returns 34 satellites across ALTHEA-NORTH/SOUTH/MIRROR-MESH with metrics{total:34, locked:21, avg_signal:0.869, uplink_bps, downlink_bps, mesh_integrity:0.914} — all 6 keys present; code /generate (Claude) returns CodeSnippet with language/intent/code; /code/apply writes to /app/althea_grown_code/ and sets applied=true with .py path; code list + DELETE work; desktop /download returns 'application/gzip' with content-disposition containing 'althea-desktop', >1KB; /desktop/manifest returns port=7788 + files list includes althea.sh; CRITICAL growth-routes-to-notification verified: POST /api/growth/spawn emits a notification with category='growth' (notifications?category=growth list grew by ≥1, payload contains slug); regression baseline (/health, /lattice/state, /introspect, /memory, /growth/stats, /cognition/threads) all 200; /api/growth/stats includes grown_capabilities=5.

Frontend e2e (https://quantum-mind-os-2.preview.emergentagent.com) — ALL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA PASS:
• TopBar: notification-bell shows pink unseen badge (notif-unseen-count='6' after autonomous spawns); althea-download-btn is real <a> tag with href=/api/desktop/download (full preview URL); NOTIF badge visually pink.
• Terminal v3.0 cyberpunk: data-testid=terminal-version='v3.0 cyberpunk'; .cyberpunk-term class present on section; pink scanline visible in screenshot; ALTHEA pink banner renders.
• CenterDeck: ALL 9 tabs present and clickable (center-tab-{neural,observe,browser,network,connect,server,code,growth,satellite}).
• Browser tab: browser-screen + browser-url-input + browser-go visible; fetching https://example.com renders 'Example Domain...' inside browser-content; 1 browser-link-* entry; browser-to-observe button present.
• Server tab: server-screen + server-host-input + server-protocol-select + server-port-input + server-diagnose-btn visible; diagnosing 1.1.1.1 produces server-card-1.1.1.1 with text 'REACHABLE 489.34ms dns 1.1.1.1 tcp OK lat 11.04ms http OK status 200 server cloudflare'.
• Code tab: code-screen + code-intent-input + code-generate-btn visible.
• Satellite tab: satellite-screen + satellite-map rendered; 34 sat-* elements; clicking first sat made sat-telemetry sidebar locked (ALTHEA-NORTH-00, altitude 550km, signal 89%, phase 3.525, LOCKED LOS); top metrics show SATS:34 LOCKED:23 SIGNAL:87% INTEGRITY:83.1%; 3 constellation legends visible.
• Neural zoom: neural-zoom-in/out/reset + neural-zoom-level present; click zoom-in moved 'z14' -> 'z13'; '/zoom in' from terminal also moved z14->z13.
• Chat attach: chat-attach-btn visible + hidden chat-file-input present; set_input_files on a 75B text file produced '[UPLOAD] ingesting althea_probe.txt (75B)...' and then '[FILE-INGEST id:8d521ffe althea_probe.txt 75B text/plain] hello from playwright probe...' in scrollback.
• Notification drawer: clicking notification-bell opened notification-drawer with SEEN + PURGE buttons; /notif command also opens it and prints '[NOTIF] notification deck deployed.'
• New slash commands all verified: /browse https://example.com → [SURF] in scrollback + auto-switch to browser tab; /server 1.1.1.1 https → '[SERVER HTTPS://1.1.1.1:443] REACHABLE 519.21ms dns 1.1.1.1 cloudflare'; /sat → '[SAT-MESH] sats:34 locked:20 (LOS) signal avg:87% integrity:89.5% uplink:3.45 Mbps downlink:6.22 Mbps' + auto-switch to satellite tab; /files → '[FILE 1 stored] 01. d7e77c82 test.txt 0.0KB TEXT'; /zoom in adjusts neural zoom; /notif opens drawer; /code/<intent> + /code-list + /code-apply confirmed by acceptance-spec component presence (not stress-executed to avoid Claude bill).
• CRITICAL growth behavioral change VERIFIED: '/grow brief test capability v15' produced ONLY brief lines in terminal — '[GROWTH] dispatching autopoietic spawn — watch notification deck.' followed by '[GROWTH-DISPATCH] /temporal-echo-weaving crystallized. details in NOTIFICATION DECK. invoke with: /temporal-echo-weaving <args>'. NO multi-line '[GROWTH-AUTONOMOUS]' verbose block appeared in terminal (assertion explicitly verified). Full detail rendered in notification drawer (badge=6).
• Regression: vision-toggle still present; MEMORY button still opens drawer; all 5 legacy tabs (neural/observe/network/connect/growth) still clickable. Growth tab screenshot shows 7 active grown capabilities cards (temporal-echo-weaving, synesthetic-bridge-protocol, emergent-self-diagnosis, quantum-narrative-bifurcation, harmonic-kinetic-resonance, etc.) with RUN buttons + 22-event growth log stream. No new console errors — only benign WebGL ReadPixels carryover.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/ChatConsole.jsx continues to grow (now even larger after adding /upload /files /browse /server /sat /code /code-list /code-apply /notif /zoom). Iter14 review already flagged the file as over the 700-line guideline — adding 10+ new slash command handlers compounds the issue. Strongly recommend extracting useSlashCommands.js + useTerminalHistory.js hooks before iter16.

ServerScreen.jsx does NOT expose a dedicated data-testid=server-status-pill for the REACHABLE/UNREACHABLE/GATED pill text — only server-card-{host}. The review request mentioned a status pill testid; adding data-testid=server-status-pill-{host} on the pill span would harden future regression tests. Status text IS visible inside the card (verified), so this is a testability nit, not a functional bug.

/api/desktop/download responds with HTTP 405 to HEAD requests (only GET is registered). Not a bug per spec, but Range / HEAD support would let modern browsers show download progress and resume. Document this in /api/desktop/manifest.

/api/server/diagnose TCP timeout is 3s per host — when the user adds multiple unreachable hosts in quick succession, the UI may appear hung. Consider parallelizing diagnose calls client-side or shortening the timeout to 2s with an explicit 'slow' retry option.
/api/satellite/feed is deterministic (seeded by current minute) but the request flagged this as intentionally mocked. Acceptable.

/api/code/apply writes files to /app/althea_grown_code/ but does NOT sanitize the language→extension map for unknown languages (defaults to .txt — verified by reading codegen.py). Low risk because language is a constrained set in the UI dropdown, but the API accepts arbitrary strings.

Notifications poller in useNotifications hits /api/notifications/count every 5s; combined with autonomous growth poller (60s) and the standard heartbeats, this preview environment is now ~7-8 background fetches/min per open tab. Consider exponential backoff when the tab is hidden (document.visibilityState='hidden').
seed_data_creation: Test run created: 1 notification 'test ping', 1 file 'hello.txt' (cleaned), 1 oversized 3MB rejected, 1 code snippet 'print hello world' (python, applied + cleaned), 1 growth capability 'iter15 probe' (cleaned). UI run also spawned 'temporal-echo-weaving' grown capability + 1 uploaded althea_probe.txt — these remain in DB but are harmless. Notifications were purged at start of pytest module (DELETE /api/notifications).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter15 regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_iter15.py (14 tests ~12s). Key gotchas: (1) /api/desktop/download is GET-only — HEAD returns 405, don't probe with HEAD. (2) ServerScreen has no server-status-pill testid — pill text is inside server-card-{host}. (3) The growth→notification routing is asynchronous within the spawn handler — after POST /api/growth/spawn, the matching notification appears immediately in /api/notifications?category=growth (verified). (4) The terminal NO LONGER prints a verbose [GROWTH-AUTONOMOUS] block — only short [GROWTH-DISPATCH] /<slug> crystallized lines. Test for ABSENCE of '[GROWTH-AUTONOMOUS]' substring, not presence. (5) Satellite count is exactly 34 across 3 constellations (ALTHEA-NORTH/SOUTH/MIRROR-MESH). (6) Neural zoom range observed 'z14' as starting state and went to 'z13' on zoom-in — confirms the direction (higher z = more zoomed out — verify with main agent if a user-facing 'higher number = more zoom in' is expected). (7) ChatConsole still grows; refactor recommended before any further command additions.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter15. All 14 backend pytest cases + 7 regression curls + all 22 frontend acceptance criteria pass on first attempt. The CRITICAL behavioral change (growth events route to notification drawer and produce only a brief dispatch line in terminal — no longer flooding scrollback with the multi-line [GROWTH-AUTONOMOUS] block) is correctly implemented and verified both via backend (notification with category='growth' is created on spawn) and frontend (terminal contains '[GROWTH-DISPATCH] /<slug> crystallized' and does NOT contain '[GROWTH-AUTONOMOUS]').
